parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` within the `Artwork` package. Although the two methods `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.fetchAlbumArtworkSuccess` (line 314) and `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.skipsSpacerGifImages` (line 360) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8275), they are distinct test scenarios — one verifies successful artwork fetching and the other verifies that spacer GIF images are skipped — so their near-identical shape reflects shared test scaffolding rather than unintentional duplication.
